_comment: Names/kinds routed to the Gemini backend FIRST (skip ComfyUI). Derived from docs/token-art-failures.csv (Lost Omens log) and docs/token-art-history/ via tools/analyze-art-failures.mjs [--history]; extend only when a group has n>=4 and a first-pass flag rate >=60% (log) or is a documented systematic failure (history). Adopted: hybrid (7/9), owlbear, dragon/young (8/13), storm/sky concepts (history: >=5/13 named failures and a documented 30-40% ComfyUI hit rate vs ~90% Gemini). Watch, not adopted: fey (3/5), dark-palette names (>=17/77), fire (>=4/31).
